content: {"reasoning":"The standing denial is CO-97 (bundling), which is a coding/payability dispute, not a medical-necessity or authorization issue, so appeal_with_necessity and peer-to-peer (both already ineffective or clinically-oriented) are misfits. To overturn a bundling determination the payer needs documentation showing the service was separate and distinct from the paid service; we have not yet attached supporting records. Resubmission is permitted since the claim was denied, not paid (CO-18 applies only to paid claims), and timely filing still has 86 days. submit_with_records is the proper next progression to substantiate separate payability.","action":"submit_with_records"}
